text:
sam: Repro on staging: int4v2 bring-up shows silent divergence during very long prefix priming (~120k tokens). Steps: prime 20k tokens, stream 1k increments. Around 110k responses deviate from fp32 baseline. Suspect KV compaction/rolloff.

maya: which commit and deploy? any GC logs?

sam: staging run on canary 0.14.3 (sha a1b2c3). Logs show a shard-swap at 6141600280 and a compaction event right after. Dump indicates a large hole in kv index (4096..16383) for some prefix hashes.

ben: that hole pattern smells like stride insertion during compaction. Have you seen truncated metadata on quantized caches before?

anika: here's short excerpt:
```
# kv index dump (trimmed)
shard-0: base=0 len=4096
shard-1: base=16384 len=4096
missing range: 4096..16383
meta_len for int4 entries = 12 (expected 16)
lookup(prefix=0x3a7b, idx=1024) -> MISS
```

leo: missing early priming entries will change the KV context and yield different outputs silently. Can you repro with KV GC off?

sam: setting REDWOOD_KV_GC_WINDOW=0 keeps int4 aligned with fp32 for the whole run. So GC/compaction implicated.

ben: difference across precisions?

anika: repro matrix -- fp32 good, int8 flaky, int4v2 consistent fail. Also noticed serializer writes shorter meta for quant slices.

maya: @eng-runtime please check serializer/packing changes in v0.14.3 touching kv_compact/serializer.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout 0.14.3 -> staging completed at 6141600278.

ben: timeline matches. If the compact path changed how offsets or metadata are packed for quant caches, compaction could compute wrong target offsets producing the hole.

qa-bot: suggestion: add a deterministic fuzz test that writes many random prefix keys, runs compact, then verifies lookups by comparing stored offsets/lengths before and after compaction. Fast and catches packing regressions.

sam: plan: 1) file RT-3421 with dumps and timeline (done), 2) add unit fuzz for serializer invariants, 3) temp mitigation: set REDWOOD_KV_GC_WINDOW=0 for staging int4 workloads.

anika: I'll generate min repro harness and attach raw kv blob and serializer debug output (REDWOOD_SERIALIZER_DEBUG=1). Also trying a re-run with shard isolation to see if swap/mesh rebalancer triggers it.

leo: if you can find the commit touching kv_compact/serializer in 0.14.3 i'll bisect. Looks likely.

sam: issue posted https://redwood.internal/issue/RT-3421 (dumps + logs). cc @eng-runtime @eng-ml.

maya: add "compaction fuzz" to onboarding checklist for quant models.

ben: added.

sam: leaving staging workaround in place. will follow up with PR for the fuzz test + fix.

anika: ping when you want more long traces, i can run overnight.

sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
